entities.summary: Obinna Julius Nwosu, is a Nigerian former professional basketball player. He played briefly for the National Basketball Association's San Antonio Spurs during the 1994–95 NBA season. He also had a career in the Lebanese Basketball League and the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA).
